title: Add server-side configuration to tokio::spawn endpoint futures
notes: Feature request: a dropshot option to tokio::spawn endpoint futures so a client disconnect cannot cancel them (motivated by omicron#3140). Implemented in dropshot#701; not itself a defect report.

title: catalog: Add shadow catalog implementation
notes: Adds a shadow catalog implementation (feature); unrelated to cancellation.

title: UniqueConnec behaviour when calling `set_until` with an existing value
notes: Design question about UniqueConnec::set_until when a value already exists (drop the new connection future or keep it); a behaviour choice, not a cancellation defect.

title: Non-cancellable handlers
notes: Feature request for a non-cancellable-handler layer (spawn the handler so client disconnects do not cancel it); redirected to tower-http. No defect.

title: `query_async` fails to return at all even with a timeout
notes: query_async appeared to never return; the reporter later found their own outer future was being cancelled ('definitely not a redis bug'). No defect identified.

title: Unclear which, if any `RecvStream::read_*` methods are cancel-safe
notes: Documentation question about the cancel-safety of RecvStream::read_*; answered by the docs PR #1764.

title: compute: refactor SequentialHydration into a synchronous interceptor (#37094)
notes: Behaviour-preserving refactor of SequentialHydration into a synchronous interceptor (cancel safety now provided by the replica task's select! loop). No defect fixed.

title: [update-engine] use cancel_safe_futures::coop_cancel
notes: Refactor: the update-engine AbortHandle now wraps cancel_safe_futures::coop_cancel. No defect described.

title: Add support for a new StreamingBody extractor
notes: Feature: StreamingBody extractor for dropshot (RFD 353). Cancel-safety comes up only in passing in review.

title: refactor(codecs): assemble final GELF chunk directly
notes: Refactor of GELF final-chunk assembly; review found (and the PR fixed) an ordering race where the timeout task was aborted only after the message-ID lock was released. A lock/abort ordering race inside new code, not a destroyed future losing state.

title: Tasks have lost their wakers
notes: tokio-console 'lost wakers' in axum serve: without graceful shutdown, a per-connection task waiting on a pending signal was never cleaned up (fixed in #3129). A task-lifecycle leak on normal completion, not triggered by cancelling a future.

title: compute: add token-controlled fuse in feedback edges
notes: Feature: a token-controlled fuse operator so dropped dataflows (including divergent WITH MUTUALLY RECURSIVE queries) stop iterating promptly. Timely dataflow shutdown, not async future cancellation.

title: [propolis-client] implement Sink for InstanceSerialConsoleHelper (#447)
notes: Commit of propolis#447 (implement Sink for InstanceSerialConsoleHelper so cancel-safe-futures combinators can be used), stated to be part of the fix for omicron#3356, the primary row.

title: pageserver: expose prometheus metrics for startup time
notes: Feature: Prometheus metrics for pageserver startup phases; review remarks the metrics are not cancel-safe but that this does not matter.

title: docs(examples): Update web_api example to use async await
notes: Docs: port the web_api example to async/await (superseded by #1872). Unrelated.

title: Cancelling an indexing task does not always stop indexing quickly
notes: Labelled bug: cancelling a Meilisearch indexing task is slow because several indexing phases never check the cancellation signal. Cooperative-cancellation responsiveness; no future is destroyed -> adjacent.

title: pageserver: improve API for invoking GC
notes: Refactor: run GC inline in the HTTP handler instead of spawning a task_mgr task; no cancellation defect described.

title: Tracking: streaming hash join optimization
notes: Tracking issue for streaming hash-join performance work; unrelated.

title: net: allow to set linger on `TcpSocket` (#4324)
notes: Feature: TcpSocket::set_linger. Motivated by dropped connect futures leaving sockets in TIME_WAIT, which is normal TCP behaviour; the change adds configurability rather than fixing a defect.

title: H1 upstream: chunked terminator 0\r\n\r\n written twice when an H2 downstream ends the request body with an empty DATA frame (END_STREAM), poisoning upstream keep-alive connections
notes: Duplicate chunked terminator when an H2 downstream ends the body with an empty END_STREAM DATA frame; an HTTP framing bug, not cancellation.

title: Inactive source cause upstream (barriermanager) and downstream (merge) to panic.
notes: A source actor exits after a Kafka consumer error; the merge executor then receives None and panics, and barrier sends fail (fixed by #736). 'Cancelled' here means the actor stopped with an error; this is error propagation, not an async future destroyed mid-operation.

title: storage: guard against `build_fallible` footgun
notes: Unmerged workaround: when a build_fallible operator future returns an error, capabilities held in its state are dropped, producing bogus frontiers. The trigger is an early error return (normal completion of the future), not cancellation.

title: Tracking "current spans" under tokio
notes: Question about how tracing tracks current spans across futures; no defect.

title: *: document `GenericClient::recv` impls as cancel safe
notes: Documentation-only commit adding cancel-safety notes to the GenericClient::recv impls (from the #28816 series); no defect fixed by this commit itself.

title: storage_sync2
notes: Large storage_sync2 rewrite (per-tenant upload queue); a mention of possible cancellation bugs in review is not a specific defect.

title: persist: extract a new shard_source operator from persist_source
notes: Refactor: extract a shard_source operator from persist_source; select!/cancellation comes up only in review remarks.

title: concurrency-limit initial logical size calculation [v2]
notes: Concurrency-limit initial logical size calculation (performance/overload fix); the cancel-safety audit comments are incidental.

title: [persist] Always perform routine maintenance
notes: Persist: stop ignoring routine maintenance returned from operations (feature/cleanup); not cancellation.

title: Add `JoinSet`
notes: Feature: adds tokio JoinSet (TaskSet); abort-on-drop semantics are discussed as part of the API design.

title: `fatxpool`: added mortal transactions integration test
notes: Adds integration tests for mortal transactions in the fork-aware tx pool; 'dropped' refers to transactions, not futures.

title: Implement wss support in proxy
notes: Feature: WebSocket (wss) support in the Neon proxy.

title: sync: reset Chan::rx_waker in chan::Rx's Drop impl
notes: Merged, with a regression test. A task polling an mpsc Receiver is aborted; the Receiver drops, but Chan::rx_waker still holds the task's waker, keeping the RawTask allocation alive while any Sender lives (a real app leak, amplified by an app-leaked Sender). Fix: take the waker in Rx::drop. Analogous to quinn#1458. Waker bookkeeping -> runtime. Medium confidence: partly hardening.

title: Unwind triggered while reading from TcpStream.
notes: A read_line 'unwind' turned out to be a normal Pending: the server waited for EOF that an HTTP client never sends. Not a defect.

title: feat/shard ops timeout backup
notes: Feature PR (shard operation timeouts / WaitTimeout status), closed quickly; no cancellation defect.

title: Cargo doc warning in tokio-io
notes: Rustdoc warning in tokio-io; unrelated.

title: Document cancelation safety `AsyncBufReadExt::fill_buf`
notes: Documentation request: the cancel safety of AsyncBufReadExt::fill_buf (it is cancel-safe); docs added in #6431.

title: docs: add guarantees to the read and send_datagram function
notes: Docs PR adding cancel-safety guarantees to quinn datagram APIs; no defect.

title: add h2::Error as a `source` for tonic::Status when converting from h2::Error
notes: Feature: expose h2::Error as the source of tonic::Status; unrelated to cancellation.

title: Retry meta request on cancelled
notes: Feature/robustness request: retry meta-service requests that fail with tonic 'Cancelled: Timeout expired' during rolling upgrades. The status name is not a future-cancellation defect.

title: stack: Make `failfast::Gate` general purpose
notes: Refactor: make failfast::Gate a general-purpose stack middleware.

title: Instance stuck waiting for NVMe pause future after controller reset
notes: Instance stuck on the NVMe pause future after Crucible IO hung; cancel-safety was suspected mid-thread, but the resolution points to a deadlocked mpsc channel / backpressure behaviour. Not a cancellation defect.

title: fs: add support for non-threadpool executors
notes: Feature: dedicated blocking pool for tokio-fs; the 'seek future dropped leaves file state undefined' note is a design caveat, not a reported defect.

title: pageserver: use tokio::time::timeout where possible (#4756)
notes: Refactor: replace select!-emulated timeouts with tokio::time::timeout after a cancel-safety review that found no issues.

title: Document possible `Mutex` deadlock in `block_in_place`
notes: Unmerged docs PR about a Mutex deadlock with block_in_place; not cancellation.

title: Better documentation on tonic::transport::Server::.timeout function
notes: Documentation request about tonic Server::timeout semantics.

title: Long-lived streaming connections don't shut down after disconnecting from Wi-Fi on Mac
notes: Streaming server takes about a minute to shut down on macOS after Wi-Fi loss while graceful on Linux; a platform/TCP teardown question, not a cancellation defect.

title: Handler future gets cancelled early when body isn't read
notes: The user reports that the hyper service_fn future seems to be cancelled early (response never received) unless the request body is read; closed by the reporter with no maintainer diagnosis. Cause not established.

title: Unify APIs for `Endpoint::closed`, `Connection::closed` and `Connection::on_closed`
notes: API design discussion about unifying the closed() futures on Endpoint/Connection.

title: fix(hummock): cancel timeout compact task
notes: Unmerged PR cancelling timed-out compaction tasks at the meta-node level (distributed task timeout, not future cancellation).

title: sql: return NULL from pg_cancel_backend(NULL) instead of panicking
notes: pg_cancel_backend(NULL) panicked in the planner; a NULL-handling bug unrelated to future cancellation.

title: Add Native Query Timeout and Safe Termination for Long-Running Queries in influxDB v2
notes: Feature request (InfluxDB v2) for server-side query timeouts; not a Rust async cancellation defect.

title: Avoid socket thrash
notes: Observed socket churn under load; the maintainer fixed it in #1585 (merged). hyper's client selects pool checkout against connect; when checkout wins, the in-progress connect future is dropped and its half-established socket closed into TIME_WAIT, so sockets thrash. Fix spawns the losing connect and pools it. Violation approximated as resource leak/churn. injectable=unknown: the symptom is kernel TIME_WAIT accumulation.

title: chore: prepare Tokio v1.53.0
notes: Release chore (Tokio v1.53.0 changelog); it lists other fixes but is not itself a defect report.

title: cherry-pick fix(stream): keep consuming on a no-op sink config update (#26484) to release-3.0
notes: Cherry-pick to release-3.0 of the fix (#26484) for #26409 (no-op ALTER SINK cancels the consumer, then the KV log reader panics 'future state is not Reset'); the issue is primary.

title: docs(stack/gate): note `Tx::lost()` cancel safety (#4482)
notes: Docs commit noting that gate Tx::lost() is cancel-safe.

title: fix(datadog_agent source): Silence the "Source send cancelled." error
notes: Unmerged PR to silence the 'Source send cancelled.' error/metric for datadog_agent (the client resends on timeout); a logging/metric choice, and users objected. Not a defect fix.

title: Support cancellation in queue proxy to forward proxy method
notes: Feature: pass a CancellationToken into queue_proxy_into_forward_proxy so a long transfer can be cancelled; the cancel-safety discussion in review ends with 'fine as-is'. No defect.

title: tests: stop uploader cleanly before killing peer in WAL delta tests
notes: Test fix: SIGKILLing a peer mid-update can leave replicas inconsistent in a WAL-delta test; process kill in a test harness, not async future cancellation.

title: Deno.serve request.signal don't work
notes: Deno.serve request.signal did not fire on client abort: a missing feature (duplicate of #10829, implemented later). JS-level cancellation signalling, not a destroyed future losing state.

title: Fix client connection deadlock [closes #326]
notes: Unmerged attempt at an h2 client connection deadlock (#326) caused by the Arc refcount / wake ordering when stream refs drop; a drop-order race, not cancellation of an in-flight operation.
